en.headline: Provisional October visitor arrivals reach 5.13 million, up 12 percent
en.dek: The Tourism Board said mainland arrivals rose 15 percent and year-to-date figures hit 45.8 million, boosted by Golden Week and major events.
body: Provisional visitor arrivals to Hong Kong reached about 5.13 million in October, a 12 percent rise from the same month last year, the Hong Kong Tourism Board said on Tuesday.

Mainland arrivals accounted for roughly 3.97 million, up 15 percent, while long-haul markets grew 19 percent. Short-haul arrivals fell 14 percent, which the board attributed to the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday falling in October the previous year.

For the first ten months of the year, cumulative arrivals reached 45.8 million, also up 12 percent. The board pointed to the National Day Golden Week, events such as the International Lantern Spectacular and the Wine and Dine Festival, plus concerts, sports fixtures and MICE activities as factors supporting the figures.
The board added that major exhibitions and events in other Greater Bay Area cities also helped facilitate regional tourism and business exchanges.

zh.headline: 10月初步訪港旅客約513萬人次 按年升12%
zh.dek: 旅發局稱內地旅客升15%，首十個月累計達4580萬人次，受黃金周及大型活動帶動。
body: 香港旅遊發展局周二公布，今年10月初步訪港旅客約513萬人次，較去年同期上升12%。
內地旅客約397萬人次，上升15%；長途市場上升19%。短途市場則下跌14%，旅發局解釋去年中秋節假期落在10月，影響按年比較。
今年首十個月累計訪港旅客達4580萬人次，同樣按年上升12%。旅發局指國慶黃金周、國際花燈會、美酒佳餚巡禮，以及演唱會、體育賽事及會展活動等帶動相關數字。
旅發局補充，大灣區其他城市的大型展覽及活動亦有助促進區域旅遊及商務交流。
